SHUN_MOD_BOSS_TROPHY.title: Boss Trophy
SHUN_MOD_BOSS_TROPHY.description: Upon killing a Boss, increase Max HP by 25%.
SHUN_MOD_BOUNTIFUL_FROND.title: Bountiful Frond
SHUN_MOD_BOUNTIFUL_FROND.description: At the start of each turn, fill your empty potion slots with random potions.
SHUN_MOD_INFINITE_GIRYA.title: Infinite Girya
SHUN_MOD_INFINITE_GIRYA.description: You may train at Rest Sites. Each training gives +1 Strength at the start of combat. No limit.
SHUN_MOD_ENDLESS_LIFE.title: Endless Life
SHUN_MOD_ENDLESS_LIFE.description: Right-click to activate. Consume any number of cards from your hand. For each card consumed, add a random upgraded card (any class) to your hand. NL It costs 0 the first time it is played. NL Gain [E] equal to the number of cards consumed.
